data.summary_en: Self-Credit, an end-to-end method for sparse-reward credit assignment in long-horizon agentic RL: generates cited summaries as self-credit, compares cited actions in successful vs. failed rollouts via intra-group rescaling, and reweights key-turn advantages; on BrowseComp-Plus it beats Qwen3 8B/32B bases by 37.0 and 36.2 points.
